patterns.note: Full-bleed images and gradient sections are used to delineate content blocks, often with text overlaid directly on them.
The site uses an extremely wide, blocky, monospaced-like sans-serif for prominent branding elements, contrasting sharply with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and descriptive labels.
A minimalist black and white base is accented by vibrant, full-bleed gradients and a distinctive bright yellow outline for key branding badges.
An initial hero animation quickly transitions to a persistent, sticky header element (a branded badge and description) that overlays subsequent content as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections, including large images and text blocks, are revealed with a fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width visual modules, often alternating between photographic collages, solid color gradients, and text-heavy blocks, creating a dynamic visual rhythm.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate complex scroll-based animations, including viewport-triggered reveals and sticky elements.
An initial loading or intro animation presents the primary branding, which then transitions to a more compact, persistent header that overlays subsequent content.
Sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up or subtle slide-in effect as they become visible in the user's viewport, creating a dynamic content flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, wide, blocky display text (~8-10x body) for branding, with smaller, uppercase labels and a clean, legible sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and contact sections, with generous vertical spacing between full-bleed content modules, creating a spacious and deliberate rhythm.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of an extremely wide and blocky display typeface for branding, which acts as both a hero and a persistent footer. This is combined with dynamic, full-bleed image and gradient sections that reveal on scroll, and a unique sticky header element that overlays content, creating a highly artistic and interactive portfolio experience.
